The first alpha of the **IdeaBlade Validation Editor**, a desktop editor for [IdeaBlade Validation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation)'s validation metadata: JSON files, TypeScript `ModelValidationMetadataMap` objects and C# JSON strings, edited in forms instead of by hand, with the library's own checks as you type.

> **Note:** What you see here was written in a few hours with the help of [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). The code hasn't been fully reviewed and vetted. It's meant as a developer tool, not a fully fleshed-out production app.

| | Download | Installing |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.1.exe](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.1.exe) | Run it. It's not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: *More info* → *Run anyway*. It installs for everyone (Program Files, with an administrator prompt) or only for you. |

It's not signed with an Apple certificate or notarized, so the first time, right-click the app → *Open* → *Open* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/IdeaBlade Validation Editor.app"`). |

| **Linux** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | `chmod +x` it and run it. |
| **Linux**, Debian or Ubuntu (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux-amd64.deb) | `sudo apt install ./IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux-amd64.deb` |

The Windows installer was checked on Windows 11. The macOS and Linux builds come from GitHub's runners and haven't been tried on those systems yet: please open an issue if they don't start.

## What's in it

- **Metadata in JSON, TypeScript or C#**, several files side by side, checked together as the library merges them. TS and C# files are rewritten only where the metadata is; the pane on the right shows the file as saving will write it.
- **Forms for everything in the metadata**: model types, `extends`, conditions, model-level rules, properties, groups, `from`, and every built-in validator's settings, plus the application's own validators and expression functions, read from its TS and C# sources.
- **Sources**: Breeze metadata, TypeScript and C# files with entities, view models and DTOs, so model types and properties are picked from lists, and typos are flagged.
- **Code completion in expressions**, a **regular expression panel** with values to try, a **JSON view** that's a code editor, and **Try it** to validate a sample object with the library itself.
- **Project files** (`*.ivproj`) to share the files, sources and settings with the team; recent projects; the last one reopens.
- **Several maps per TS or C# file** (Add map), and dragging model types and maps between maps and files, merging where they meet.
- Files are watched: changes made outside the editor are offered for reloading, and saving warns before overwriting them.

See the [README](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/README.md) for the details, and the [library's documentation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation/tree/main/docs) for the metadata itself.
